import json,sys
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
jobs=d.get('jobs',[])
print('status:', d['status'], d.get('conclusion') or '')
print('jobs:', len(jobs), dict(Counter(j.get('conclusion') for j in jobs)))
fails=[j['name'] for j in jobs if j.get('conclusion') not in ('success','skipped',None,'')]
print('FAILED:', fails[:10] if fails else 'none')
"
